rewrites.comment: Single-page app: React Router owns the URL, so any path that is not a real file must serve index.html. Vercel checks the filesystem before applying rewrites, so hashed assets and favicon.ico are still served directly. Without this, opening or refreshing /lessons returns a 404.

headers.comment: Vite fingerprints these filenames, so a new build produces new names and a stale cache can never be served.
